_doc: Art pipeline manifest. One entry per asset. tools/art/blender_process.py reads this. Paths are relative to the repo root. Raw inputs live in raw/ (gitignored); rebuild them with tools/art/fetch_tripo.sh. yaw_deg turns the model about up so its front faces glTF +Z (Tripo output faces +X, so -90). target: exactly one of height/width/length in metres, or fit {x,y,z} for a per-axis fit (Blender axes after yaw, z up). origin: bottom_center | center | grip. collision: trimesh | convex | null (Godot node-name suffix -col / -convcol).

source.remesh_operator: none: Tripo remesh failed twice on this model; decimated locally to 40k tris (decim.py) and re-imported
source.note: Tripo remesh failed twice on this model (once after tripo_segment); decimated locally and re-imported, then rigged
